{{Quote|IN-GA, secure our place on the diplomatic shuttle to Etti Four.|Jahan Cross, to [[IN-GA 44]]|<ref name="Agent" />}}
'''Imperial Shuttle 9604''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] used by [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps|Diplomatic Service]] branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|Roger, Imperial Shuttle Niner Six Zero Four. You are cleared for landing on Imperial pad six niner three. Welcome to the Corporate Sector. May your stay be profitable|Mondder spaceport control welcoming Imperial Shuttle 9604|<ref name="Agent" />}}
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] this [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was used by Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companion [[IN-GA 44]] to travel to [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] to follow a lead on the [[Iron Eclipse]] project. They arrived at [[Mondder Spaceport]] on [[Imperial Pad 693]] to meet with the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], [[Blains Vorlin]].<ref name="Agent" />

==Appearances==
*[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]
